subject: Publisher MAP kickoff: joint ops & evaluation timeline for Cloud Marketplaces
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lina Chen <lina@cloudbridge.com>, Acme Retail <procurement@acmeretail.com>, GCP Marketplace Ops <gcp-marketplace-ops@google.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Publisher MAP kickoff: joint ops & evaluation timeline for Cloud Marketplaces

Hi Lina / Acme team / marketplace ops,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off a mutual action plan for listing Redwood Inference in the cloud publisher channels (GCP and AWS) and to coordinate the evaluation plan with Acme Retail. Attached is a first-pass MAP and a short security evidence bundle to help streamline Acme’s procurement review.

High-level asks in this email:
- Confirm the right partner ops contact for AWS Marketplace (we copied GCP above).
- Confirm an initial 60–90 minute kickoff where we can walk through the MAP and dependency owners.
- Review the attached MAP-draft-v1.xlsx and add any missing milestones or dates on the shared sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AbCdEfG_MAP_draft

Draft MAP highlights (attached):
- Week 1: Technical evaluation & sandbox listing prep (test images, pricing SKU)
- Week 2–3: Security evidence (SOC2 + QSA items) + integration test plan
- Week 4: Marketplace listing validation + Acme evaluation window (P0: performance SLA checks)
- Close target: 2026-09-17 (aiming for a 3–4 week evaluation + listing cadence)

Tentative kickoff slots (PST):
- Tue 2026-08-24 10:00–11:30
- Tue 2026-08-24 15:00–16:30
- Wed 2026-08-25 09:00–10:30

Please reply with a preferred slot and any additional stakeholders to include. I’ve CC’d Marissa (sales lead), Marcus (partner ops), and Sergio (solutions/engineering) who will be owners for the items in the MAP.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (MAP spreadsheet), security-qsa.pdf (procurement evidence stub)

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partnerships & GTM
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0146
From: Lina Chen <lina@cloudbridge.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Acme Retail <procurement@acmeretail.com>
Cc: GCP Marketplace Ops <gcp-marketplace-ops@google.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher MAP kickoff: joint ops & evaluation timeline for Cloud Marketplaces

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks — excited to get this moving. I can take the partner ops lead on the CloudBridge side and coordinate with AWS/GCP listing teams. I attached our onboarding doc (CloudBridge-Onboard.pdf) with the typical checklist and estimated lead times.

Quick notes:
- We can support the Week 1 sandbox work and provide a test account for Acme to run performance checks.
- For AWS Marketplace we’ll need confirmation of the SKU/pricing model by EOD 2026-08-30 to meet the target listing date.
- Security: CloudBridge can provide the basic compliance attestations; any Redwood-specific logs or audit hooks that Acme requires we should scope during the kickoff.

Preferred kickoff times for our engineering/product ops: Tue 2026-08-24 15:00 PST or Wed 2026-08-25 09:00 PST. If those work for Acme, please lock the calendar and share an agenda.

Cheers,
Lina Chen
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge
lina@cloudbridge.com
Attachments: CloudBridge-Onboard.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-24T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher MAP kickoff: joint ops & evaluation timeline for Cloud Marketplaces

Vanessa — quick internal mapping so we can go into the kickoff with clear owners.

Owner matrix (proposed):
- Sales/Commercial (customer liaison): Marissa Cole — run Acme pricing/contract cadence, negotiate trial terms
- Partner Ops (marketplace listing coordination): Marcus Lin — AWS/GCP listing, packaging, SKU mapping
- Solutions/Technical (integration & test plan): Sergio Alvarez — sandbox config, performance test harness
- Security/Compliance (evidence collection): Vanessa Ortiz + Security team (I’ll loop the security PM after kickoff)

I’ll prepare a one-pager on proposed trial terms and a short checklist for procurement to speed the Acme evaluation. Marcus — can you confirm the earliest available listing slot for GCP (we sometimes need a 3–5 day validation window)?

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lina Chen <lina@cloudbridge.com>, Acme Retail <procurement@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, GCP Marketplace Ops <gcp-marketplace-ops@google.com>, AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher MAP kickoff: joint ops & evaluation timeline for Cloud Marketplaces

Thanks everyone — locking Tue 2026-08-24 15:00 PST (we’ll run 75 minutes to cover the MAP and technical checklists). Lina — thanks for the onboarding doc. Agenda and dial-in will follow; for now the agreed next steps and owners: 

Action items (owners & targets):
1) Finalize MAP dates in shared sheet — Owner: Vanessa Ortiz — Due: 2026-08-26 EOD (I’ll incorporate Marissa’s pricing items).
2) Confirm AWS SKU/pricing model — Owner: CloudBridge (Lina Chen) & Marcus Lin — Due: 2026-08-30 EOD.
3) Provide sandbox test account and test plan to Acme — Owner: CloudBridge (Lina Chen) & Sergio Alvarez — Due: 2026-09-02.
4) Security evidence package (SOC2 scope + audit hooks) — Owner: Vanessa Ortiz / Redwood Security PM — Due: 2026-08-31.
5) Acme to run evaluation & provide feedback (performance & integration) — Owner: Acme Retail (procurement + engineering) — Target window: 2026-09-03 to 2026-09-10.

Meeting invite to follow. For bookkeeping I’ll add this thread to HubSpot and attach the MAP draft (HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345). If anyone needs a different time slot, say so now — otherwise see you Tuesday.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partnerships & GTM
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0146
Attachments referenced: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx, security-qsa.pdf
